questions.question: When Jesus' disciples admired the temple's beautiful stones, what did Jesus say would happen to those stones?

answers.text: Not one would be left on another
They would last a thousand years
They would all be covered in gold

questions.question: Jesus warned that many would come in His name claiming 'I am He.' What did He tell His disciples to guard against?
Jesus said His followers would be brought before kings and governors. What did He call that time?

answers.text: A chance to serve as witnesses
A sign the end has come

questions.question: What did Jesus say would show His disciples that Jerusalem would soon be laid waste?

answers.text: A new star over the city
